from pathlib import Path
import re, subprocess, tempfile
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="bit-chamfer-invariant-") as temporary:
    output = Path(temporary) / "chamfer.csg"
    result = subprocess.run(["openscad", "-o", str(output), "tests/v4/scad/test_chamfer_n.scad"], capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=60)
    diagnostics = result.stdout + result.stderr
    if result.returncode != 0:
        raise RuntimeError(diagnostics or f"OpenSCAD exited {result.returncode}")
    if not output.is_file() or output.stat().st_size == 0:
        raise RuntimeError("missing or empty chamfer CSG")
    if re.search(r"^(?:WARNING|ERROR):|BGSD_WARNING", diagnostics, re.MULTILINE):
        raise RuntimeError(diagnostics)
print("PASS: corrected mixed-chamfer fixture compiles without compiler or physical-validation warnings")
